entries.expectedBehavior: Compiled firmware observes the fixed 5 V source as D3 HIGH while the independent D2 ground path follows the button.
entries.limits: AVR-only topology projection to the board 5 V output; no independent supply, regulator, source impedance, current capacity, short-circuit, earth or chassis model.
